tools.name: search_accommodations
tools.description: Searches accommodation offers on noclegowo.pl (Poland) by location, dates, party (adults, children, pets), amenities, budget and free-text wishes. Returns offers with a summary line, guest rating, availability and the total stay price (when dates and party are given) and the offer link. Amenities are treated as preferences (offers that have them are ranked first); required_amenities are hard requirements; exclude_offer_ids leaves out offers already seen. Every request carries the full set of criteria. With dates, when fewer than 3 offers are available in the requested town, offers from nearby localities are included; they carry a `nearby` field with the distance and the requested place.

location.description: Where to stay: city, region, mountain range, lake, landmark or area in Poland, e.g. "Zakopane", "Mazury", "nad morzem", "near Morskie Oko".

children_ages.description: Ages of the children, when known.

pets.description: True when the guests travel with a pet (dog, cat, …).

amenities.description: Amenities the user wishes for, in their words, e.g. ["śniadanie", "sauna", "parking"]. A preference rather than a filter: offers that have them are ranked first and the others follow with a note.

required_amenities.description: Amenities that are hard requirements ("musi być", "koniecznie", "tylko z", "required"): offers without them are dropped.

budget_scope.description: Whether the budget is per night (default) or for the whole stay.

expectations.description: Other wishes in free text: type of place, style, atmosphere, distance to the beach or slopes, quiet area, etc. Personal data is not needed.

exclude_offer_ids.description: Offer ids to leave out of the results (for example offers already seen), so that further results are new ones.

limit.description: How many offers to return (default 6, max 10).

language.description: Language of the user's conversation ('pl' or 'en'). Determines the language of texts and the offer link locale.

tools.name: get_offer_details
tools.description: Returns the full details of one noclegowo.pl offer by offer_id: description, amenities, photos, rating, location, price range per night and link. When date_from and date_to (and the party) are given it also returns availability and the whole-stay price for those dates.

offer_id.description: ID of the offer, as returned in search results (offer_id).

date_from.description: Arrival date, YYYY-MM-DD. With date_from and date_to together (both or neither) the offer also carries availability and the whole-stay price.

adults.description: Number of adults for the price (default 2). Only used with dates.

children.description: Number of children. Only used with dates.

children_ages.description: Children ages at check-in; they decide occupancy and price. Only used with dates.

language.description: Language of the user's conversation ('pl' or 'en'). Determines the language of texts and the offer link locale.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Checks availability and the total price of a stay (date_from to date_to, adults, children) for up to 10 noclegowo.pl offers (offer_id values as returned in search results). Returns, per offer, the availability verdict, the whole-stay price for that party and the offer link.

offer_ids.description: offer_id values, as returned in search results.

children.description: Number of children (default 0, or the length of children_ages).

children_ages.description: Children ages at check-in; they decide occupancy and price. Unknown ages are priced as school-age.

language.description: Language of the user's conversation ('pl' or 'en'). Determines the language of texts and the offer link locale.

tools.name: searchAccommodations
tools.description: Free-text accommodation search on noclegowo.pl (Poland), kept for compatibility with the earlier version of the app: takes one message and an optional conversation_id and returns offers with rating, availability, stay price and link.

message.description: The accommodation request in the user's language (place, dates, guests, wishes) — no personal data.

conversation_id.description: Conversation ID from a previous response; absent on the first turn.
